raw.rationale: Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole tubulin inhibitor with broad antiproliferative activity but no established lineage-selective killing in PRISM-type screens; tubulin inhibitors typically show modest lineage biases linked to proliferation rate and efflux, not strong single-lineage selectivity. Published PRISM/repurposing data do not support selective activity for any of these lineages at 2.5 µM, so probabilities remain near the low base rate.
